decisions.reason: The rye country bread fits the core range and uses existing production, so holding the option costs little, and no evidence of weak demand has appeared.
The premium raisin stollen is the firm's medal-winning flagship and has realized its value, which justifies continued commitment.

The dark malt rye bread overlaps with other rye products, the closest of which (C) was already dropped, so it is the most likely candidate for pruning, but low holding costs still favor keeping it for now.
The marzipan stollen is a cheap seasonal complement to the strong stollen business, so the option stays open for another Christmas season.
The ancient grain bread is the firm's newest showcased masterpiece and its prospects are still unfolding, so dropping it would be premature.
